question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spill the beans
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Spill the beans"** means to reveal secret information unintentionally or deliberately. (गुप्त जानकारी उजागर करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He spilled the beans about the surprise party before anyone could stop him.
 
 
 
• The correct meaning of this idiom is "To tell people secret information." (लोगों को गुप्त जानकारी बताना)
 
 
• **Example:** She spilled the beans about the company's new product launch during the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To cook a meal** (एक भोजन पकाना): Refers to the act of preparing food.

 
 
• **Example:** She loves to cook a meal for her family every weekend.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To clean up a mess** (गंदगी को साफ करना): Refers to the act of tidying up a disorganized or dirty space.
 
 
• **Example:** After the party, we had to clean up the mess left in the living room.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To drop something accidentally** (कुछ गलती से गिराना): Refers to unintentionally letting go of an object.
 
 
• **Example:** He dropped the glass accidentally while washing dishes.
 
 

31:T9d4,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
